checks.name: repository-preflight
argv:
set -eu
sdk="$1"
target="$2"
tests="$3"
runner="$4"
locked="$5"
[ "$target" != __REQUIRED_TARGET__ ] && [ "$tests" != __REQUIRED_TEST_PROJECT__ ] || { echo 'dotnet-web: configure explicit solution/project and test project in repository recipe overrides' >&2; exit 2; }
for path in "$target" "$tests"; do
 case "$path" in /*|../*|*/../*|*/..|-*) echo 'dotnet-web: targets must be repository-relative paths' >&2; exit 2;; esac
 [ -f "$path" ] || { echo "dotnet-web: missing target: $path" >&2; exit 2; }
done
case "$runner" in VSTest|Microsoft.Testing.Platform) ;; *) echo 'dotnet-web: unsupported test runner declaration' >&2; exit 2;; esac
case "$locked" in true|false) ;; *) echo 'dotnet-web: locked restore must be true or false' >&2; exit 2;; esac
actual=$(dotnet --version) || { echo 'dotnet-web: prepare the declared SDK; no host installation is performed' >&2; exit 2; }
[ "$actual" = "$sdk" ] || { echo "dotnet-web: selected SDK $actual differs from declared SDK $sdk; inspect global.json and installed SDKs" >&2; exit 2; }
